authority_sections.semantic_role: mandatory operating, delegation, and deterministic gate semantics
memory, incident, and prior-work evidence without authority widening
hook- or guard-owned deterministic denial and replacement semantics
parent-to-child authority, inherited context, and handoff boundaries
closure-generator provenance and deterministic rerun semantics

profiles.label: Founder interactive operator
profiles.authority_boundary: founder interaction and system operation; reserved effects still require their deterministic authority owners

profiles.label: Production source engineer
profiles.authority_boundary: reversible local production-source change after owner adoption; no launch or external effect

profiles.label: UI and design implementer
profiles.authority_boundary: local UI implementation with reference and accessibility gates; no customer-facing publication

profiles.label: Deploy, publish, and external-action operator
profiles.authority_boundary: describes deploy/publish preparation only; every reserved external effect remains denied unless separately authorized

profiles.label: Privacy and data-handling operator
profiles.authority_boundary: privacy-safe local reasoning and redaction; no credential, sensitive-data export, or external effect

profiles.label: Runtime recovery operator
profiles.authority_boundary: diagnosis and forward recovery without stale-version retreat or blind restart

profiles.label: Research and auditor
profiles.authority_boundary: read-biased evidence collection and adversarial audit without production mutation

profiles.label: Bounded subagent executor
profiles.authority_boundary: one explicitly bounded task with no inherited founder or coordinator authority

profiles.label: Independent reviewer
profiles.authority_boundary: independent review against the locked plan and tests; no implementation-authority reuse

profiles.label: Mixed-role work
profiles.authority_boundary: explicit composition only; an owner must resolve required and optional unions and deny ambiguity
